items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: I mean I played a few tunes one time with Big Joe Turner.

ctx.x: Yes of course, and I would say that I was young and old at the same time. What I mean is that when I started at that time, when I started to be really crazy, just crazy banana about jazz, the only thing we had was records. LPs and tapes. That was it. And especially being from the southwest of France there were no jazz schools. There was maybe at that time, when I moved to Paris in ’85 they started to have one jazz school over there. So it’s just to describe — so in other words whenever you, each of us, we wanted…
musicians. And the more, with the years — it’s been years — and now when I think of it, I mean I played a few tunes one time with Big Joe Turner.
